deadline.value: No school-specific deadline is listed; the university's general rule is that there is no deadline for most schools.
deadline.quote: There is no deadline to apply for research study for most Academic Schools at the University, but there are exceptions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: You must identify a School supervisor who has agreed to supervise your project before applying.
supervisor.quote: have identified a supervisor in the School who has agreed to supervise your research project

funding.value: School Handsel fee-waiver awards are competitively awarded; other funding is listed on the School and University scholarship pages.
funding.quote: This scholarship can pay the full international fees for suitably qualified PhD or MSc (Res) students and is competitively awarded.

entry_route.value: Apply with an honours first degree at 2.1 or the overseas equivalent.
entry_route.quote: A good first degree with Honours at 2.1 (UK) or the overseas equivalent.

fee_waiver.value: The School's Handsel scholarship can cover full international fees for PhD students, but it is competitive.
fee_waiver.quote: This scholarship can pay the full international fees for suitably qualified PhD or MSc (Res) students and is competitively awarded.

notes: The Handsel news item is dated 2022; confirm the current round with the School.
